intro.text: Since 2013, we have been caring for people with serious medical conditions. With a team of registered specialists, we guarantee 24/7 care at the highest level — in the patient's own home or in cooperating residential projects in the Kassel and Waldeck-Frankenberg area.

moment.title: Life stays where it belongs.
moment.text: Ventilation, tracheostomy, persistent vegetative state — even serious conditions can be cared for within your own four walls. A certified nurse is on hand around the clock, and the costs are usually covered by health and long-term care insurance.
moment.alt: Family with a caregiver on a walk in the garden

about.title: Who We Are
about.text: KSK Farmos GmbH & Co. KG was founded in 2013 by Viktor Beresnev in Volkmarsen. Since then, we have been caring for patients across Hesse — with heart, expertise, and state-of-the-art equipment.
about.highlight: 5.5 staff per patient — far above the industry average.
